title: Repeat-meal logging (recent / frequent / same-as-yesterday)
goal: Cut logging friction for repeat meals — the #1 retention gap vs MFP/Lose It/Yazio
steps: Add 'Recent' and 'Frequent' sections to the food search screen, ordered by recency/frequency from local DB

All UI strings in Egyptian Arabic, RTL-verified, zero-blame tone
acceptance: Re-logging yesterday's breakfast takes max 2 taps from Home
Saved meals persist across app restarts
